lines.text: Open in Lagos first, then Atlanta and London: that is where your comps' audience is strongest among your cities.
Keep your target of people aged 25 to 34, but lead the creative with people 35 to 44, then 55 and over, leaning male, where these comps are strongest.
Build the soundtrack and launch music around Tems and Ayo Jay, who rank highest with this audience in Atlanta.
Lead with what the story is about: It follows a bank clerk in Lagos who gets pulled into a heist she can't walk away from.
Pitch it to buyers and press in the company of Gangs of Lagos, King of Boys and The Brotherhood.
The core audience is people 35 to 44, then 55 and over, leaning male.
Your target of people aged 25 to 34 is younger than the comps' core, so keep it for media buying and lead the creative with people 35 to 44, then 55 and over, leaning male.
In Atlanta they also play Tems, Ayo Jay and Libianca.
In Lagos they also play Tems, Burna Boy and Rema.
In London they also play Tems, Maleek Berry and Omah Lay.
Screen at Landmark's Midtown Art Cinema and Plaza Theatre.
Screen at Everyman Baker Street and Curzon Mayfair.
Plan Lagos as a lead market: book wide and put the cast there on opening weekend.
In Lagos, the audience is strongest around Victoria Island and Surulere.
This is a lead from a few points near the centre of Lagos, not a measured neighbourhood. Walk it or ask someone local before you book anything.
Put one small activation in Victoria Island, such as a screening, a signing, a listening event or flyers with a local venue, and note who turns up.
Judge it on Advance screenings and presales from Victoria Island, against Lagos as a whole.
In Atlanta, the audience is strongest around Downtown and Midtown.
